chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from one of the two (Imams) عليهما السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man does not know whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two. He said: He repeats.

key_terms.رَجُلٌ: a man; the person asking about whose case the ruling is given
key_terms.لَا يَدْرِي: does not know; is uncertain or doubtful
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats; he must perform the prayer again

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts whether he prayed one rakʿah or two in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer). If a person does not know whether he has performed one rakʿah or two, he must repeat the prayer.
